title: Chapter 47 Sky Eagle City
content:
Chapter 47 Sky Eagle City

On the other side, Lu Xue gradually came from the barren land to a more prosperous city.

Looking at the city in front of her, Lu Xue immediately thought of the deserted city.

Homesickness is self-evident.

Soon, Lu Xue entered the huge city called Sky Eagle City.

As soon as she entered the city, all kinds of strange creatures came into view.

However, many of the humanoid creatures caught Lu Xue's attention.

In her opinion, those creatures were no different from her, but they just looked stronger.

And the creatures in the city didn't pay much attention to Lu Xue, a human, at most they looked at her with bad intentions.

On the spot, Lu Xue took a deep breath, and then slowly walked towards the city.

Lu Xue didn't know that in the dark, a pair of fascinating eyes were staring at her closely.

A moment later, Lu Xue stopped in front of a teahouse.

Because at this moment, in this teahouse, an old man was sitting there quietly drinking tea.

That is, the human race!

"Senior, are you, are you a human?"

Lu Xue sat opposite the old man and asked nervously.

This is the first human she has seen in the world of all spirits.

When the old man heard Lu Xue's words, he almost choked.

"You little girl, why are you still scolding people?"

Seeing that the old man was really a human, Lu Xue was immediately overjoyed.

Finally saw a human.

All along the way, she had seen some strange creatures.

She felt a little sick.

"Senior, are you alone?"

Lu Xue asked.

The old man nodded calmly, then glanced at Lu Xue and said, "Is this your first time going out?"

Lu Xue nodded.

I guess so.

And as soon as she went out, she came to this unfamiliar world.

Then the old man nodded in understanding and said, "No wonder."

At this time, Lu Xue said again: "Senior, I, this is my first time out, I don't understand many things, can you tell me?"

Looking at Lu Xue's pitiful face.

The old man snorted, "Don't think that you and I are of the same race, I will, "

However, before he finished speaking, a crystal clear crystal was placed in front of the old man.

Seeing this scene, the old man was stunned.

Then he quickly put the crystal away at an indescribable speed.

"Ahem, hahaha, you and I are of the same race. Now that our human race is weak, we naturally have to support each other. If you don't understand anything, just ask me. Although I am not strong, I know a lot of things."

In an instant, the old man's attitude turned 180 degrees.

This is the magic of money.

Seeing this, Lu Xue also breathed a sigh of relief.

Fortunately, she has a lot of things, and there are still a lot of things in her ring that are more advanced than the crystal.

A rich woman.

No, to be precise, a rich second generation.

Then, Lu Xue asked about the most basic things.

For example, the realm division of the Ten Thousand Spirit Realm.

The realm of the Ten Thousand Spirit Realm is mainly divided into the Earth Realm and the Heaven Realm.

The Earth Realm is divided into nine levels, from the first level to the ninth level. The more you go back, the greater the difference in strength between each level.

As for the Heaven Realm, there are not many Heaven Realm powerhouses in the entire Ten Thousand Spirit Realm.

Generally, when you reach the eighth or ninth level of the Earth Realm, you can become a powerful person.

Only some powerful clans have Heaven Realm powerhouses.

Of course, the Heaven Realm is also divided.

It is divided into four levels in total.

They are the Heavenly Man Realm, the Heavenly King Realm, the Heavenly Monarch Realm, and the last legendary Heavenly Fate Realm.

However, the old man did not know so much. For him, he only knew that above the Earth Realm was the Heaven Realm.

Because he was just a cultivator of the third level of the Earth Realm.

Hearing this, Lu Xue was speechless.

I didn't expect that I was so weak that I didn't even have the Earth Realm.

Fortunately, I had a set of divine clothes and a backup plan left by my father, so I didn't have to worry about my life.

I didn't know what level my father was in the Ten Thousand Spirits Realm.

At least he must be at the seventh or eighth level of the Earth Realm.

Lu Xue thought so.

At this time, the old man smiled and said, "Little girl, I don't know where you came from?"

With such a generous hand, the old man immediately suspected that the other party would not be a disciple of a great power.

After all, some great powers do not consider race when accepting disciples, and it is very common to accept a human as a disciple.

Hearing this, Lu Xue was stunned for a moment, and then said, "I, I came from the Deserted City."

"Desolate City?"

The old man frowned slightly.

No matter how hard he thought, he couldn't think of any information about the Deserted City.

Could it be that this girl really just came out of a corner somewhere and happened to encounter some opportunities?

If that's the case, then she's in danger.

But it's not ruled out that the other party is lying.

The old man took a sip of tea and immediately fell into deep thought.

And at this moment, a figure suddenly appeared beside the two of them.

It was a three-eyed humanoid creature.

Three-eyed tribe!

"Old man, I want to buy this human, you name a price."

He spoke directly to the old man.

Obviously thought Lu Xue was the old man's person.

Because this old man is at least a third-level earth realm strongman, not weak.

As for Lu Xue, he didn't look at her much. With such a weak aura, how strong can she be.

Hearing this, the old man was stunned, and then said: "Sorry, this girl is not my person, I just met her."

Hearing this, the three-eyed creature immediately laughed and said, "That is to say, it is an ownerless thing."

The old man did not speak.

Although he and Lu Xue are both human, it is really a loss to offend the three-eyed tribe for Lu Xue.

At least it is a loss at present.

After all, the three-eyed tribe has a lot of power in the world of all spirits.

So he was hesitating whether to help.

Seeing this, the three-eyed creature smiled even more, not noticing that Lu Xue's face was getting darker and darker.

Do you really think you are easy to bully?

Then Lu Xue stood up and glared at the three-eyed creature.

"Hmm? A mere ant dares to stare at me. It's your blessing that I like you."

He sneered and grabbed Lu Xue with one hand.

But the next moment, there was a bang.

A force shook him back again and again.

I saw that an indescribable force perfectly wrapped Lu Xue up.

"You actually have a rare treasure?"

The three-eyed creature looked surprised.

The old man beside him also breathed a sigh of relief. It seemed that he had thought too much.

This woman of the same clan was indeed extraordinary.

At this time, Lu Xue had already flipped through the storage ring again.

At this time, the three-eyed creature did not know that his death was approaching.

"Okay, it's you."

Lu Xue took out a sharp sword directly, and the gorgeous runes on it kept flowing.

The next moment, the long sword automatically floated up and kept circling around Lu Xue, obviously very close to Lu Xue.

This sword has spirit.

And the spirit is very high.

Obviously, the creatures watching the excitement around also saw this and were shocked.

A weak human actually has such a magic sword.

And the three-eyed creature also frowned.

Obviously, he also began to be cautious.

"Which force are you from?"

The three-eyed creature said solemnly.

A human race, with a treasure, has no other possibility except joining a big force.

And this human race woman looks so weak.

Lu Xue glared at the three-eyed creature and said in a low voice: "Desolate City."

"Desolate City?"

The three-eyed creature was full of confusion, why had he never heard of it.

The creatures around him were also like this.

Seeing that all the creatures were confused, Lu Xue shook his head helplessly, and then pointed at the three-eyed creature and said: "Kill him for me!"

The next moment, the floating sword beside Lu Xue suddenly burst out with a shocking sword energy.

A huge sword sound rang out.

The three-eyed creature was stunned in place.

A breeze blew past.

Its head slowly fell down.

At this moment, you could hear a pin drop in the field.

Dengdeng.

The people watching the excitement around couldn't help but retreat again and again.

The eyes looking at Lu Xue were also full of horror.
